senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; נָתַן)gift, present, donation; grant, privilege.
units: Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ bot. איזו היא מ׳ … מ׳ וכ׳ what is a mattanah? All my property be given to—as a gift from now, contrad. to דִּיאֲתִיקִי.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 147a:4">B. Bath. 147ᵃ</cite> <he>מניין למַתְּנַת שכיב וכ׳</he> how can it be proven that the donation of one expecting to die is legal by Biblical law (without formal possession)? <cite ref="Kiddushin 6b:13">Kidd. 6ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ ע״מ להחזיר שמה מ׳</he> a present made with the condition that it must be returned, is legally a present (the recipient’s property for the time being); a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M03070"><he>מַתָּנוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 5a:20">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>מַתְּנוֹת כהונה</he>, v. <cite ref="K00152"><he>כְּהוּנָּה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 2:7">Tosef. Dem. II, 7</cite> <he>מ׳ גבולין</he> the priestly privileges outside of the Temple.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 2:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>יש לו במ׳</he> has a right to priestly gifts.

<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 2:13">Tosef. Peah II, 13</cite> <he>ארבע מ׳ בכרם</he> there are four gifts for the poor connected with the vineyard; <cite ref="Chullin 131a:11">Ḥull. 131ᵃ</cite> <he>מַתְּנוֹת עניים</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (Lev. VIII, 15) sprinkling or smearing the blood (on the altar &c.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:1">Zeb. V, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ אחת מהן וכ׳</he> one of those applications if omitted makes the sacrifice invalid.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:10">Ib. VIII, 10</cite> <he>הנתנין מ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> blood of a sacrifice which requires only one application if mixed with blood &c., v. <cite ref="M03082"><he>מַתָּן</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Ib. V, 3</cite> <he>ארבע מ׳ על וכ׳</he> four applications (with the finger dipped in the blood) at the four corners.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>שתי מ׳ שהן ארבע</he> two sprinklings appearing like four, i.e. towards two opposite corners of the altar; a. fr.
